name: Workspace Domain-Wide API Delegation
description: Domain-wide delegation lets a Google Cloud service account act as any user in Workspace — read mail, change calendars, drive files. It is meant for migration tools. In an attacker's hands it is a master key that does not need each user's password. New delegations, especially to a project the identity team does not know, are persistence at tenant scope. Review delegated scopes the same way you review Global Admin.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
